title.zh: 同时满足、按优先级与规则顺序
title.en: Match all, Priority and rule order

description.zh: 使用条件和目标筛选有各自独立的组合模式；它们与行动规则的先后顺序不同。
description.en: Use conditions and target filters have independent combination modes, separate from action rule order.

steps.zh: 需要同时满足血量、魔法等门槛时选择“同时满足”；任一条件即可触发时选择“按优先级”。
steps.en: Choose Match all for mandatory health and mana gates; choose Priority when any clause may trigger the action.

steps.zh: 目标筛选按优先级时，先找第一项有合法可用目标的组，再按目标排序挑选；后面的筛选不是额外限制。
steps.en: Priority target filters use the first tier with legal viable candidates, then rank within it. Later filters are not additional requirements.

steps.zh: 血量≤50%并且距离≤600，应放在“同时满足”。想优先治疗指定队友、否则治疗其他低血量友军，可将指定友方与低血量筛选放到“按优先级”，但指定友方组不受后面的血量门槛约束。
steps.en: HP ≤50% AND distance ≤600 requires Match all. To prefer a specified ally and otherwise heal low-health allies, use Priority tiers; the specified-ally tier is not constrained by the later health filter.

value.zh: 最多4个使用条件、4个目标筛选、2个排序；每英雄最多32条规则。
value.en: Up to 4 use conditions, 4 target filters and 2 priorities; 32 rules per hero.

notes.zh: 留空不增加限制；已填条件全部不匹配则失败。排序只在合格目标之间比较，不是条件门槛。
notes.en: Empty lists add no gate; populated lists with no match fail. Priorities rank eligible targets rather than imposing thresholds.

notes.zh: 引擎先尝试非普攻规则，再尝试普攻。开始追击会占用本次决策；技能追击期间仅前面的非普攻规则可抢占，普攻追击会让位给非普攻规则。
notes.en: The engine evaluates non-attack rules before attacks. Starting a chase consumes the decision; an ability chase yields only to earlier non-attack rules, while an attack chase yields to non-attack rules.

title.zh: 等待射程与自动接近目标
title.en: Wait for range and automatically approach

description.zh: 接近策略决定射程外目标能否触发追击，不会扩大原生施法距离。
description.en: Approach policy determines whether out-of-range targets trigger a chase; it does not extend native cast range.

steps.zh: 打开行动的条件设置，在接近策略中选择“等待进入射程”或“自动接近目标”。
steps.en: Open action settings and choose Wait for target to enter range or Approach target automatically.

steps.zh: 选择自动接近后填写追击超时，点击应用；再次打开会保留设置。
steps.en: For automatic approach, enter a chase timeout and Apply. Reopening retains the value.

value.zh: 0.1～120秒，可填小数；技能、物品和普攻默认3秒。
value.en: 0.1–120 seconds, including decimals; skills, items and attacks default to 3 seconds.

value.zh: 距本次追击起点的水平直线位移最多2000，不是累计行走路程。
value.en: Up to 2000 horizontal units from the chase start, not cumulative path length.

notes.zh: 等待模式只选射程内合格目标；找不到时可继续尝试后续规则。自动接近模式可以选射程外合格目标，接近到原生射程后再施放。
notes.en: Wait mode selects eligible in-range targets and can fall through if none exist. Automatic approach may choose an eligible out-of-range target and cast after entering native range.

notes.zh: 超时、超过位移限制或目标不再合法会结束当前追击；重新评估时同一规则仍可能立即再次开始追击。120秒不是保证追满120秒，控制、条件和目标变化仍会影响执行。
notes.en: Timeout, displacement limits or invalid targets end the chase. Reevaluation can immediately select the same rule again. A 120-second setting does not guarantee 120 seconds of movement; control, conditions and targets still matter.

title.zh: 面向敌人筛选与背离敌人撤退
title.en: Facing filters and retreating away from enemies

description.zh: 面向敌人是角度检查；米拉娜跳跃和对自身原力法杖的背离目标模式会先转身再施放。
description.en: Facing an enemy is an angle check. Mirana Leap and self Force Staff can turn away from an enemy before casting.

steps.zh: 面向发动的技能：目标选敌方，目标筛选选同时满足，添加F41面向敌人及距离上限。
steps.en: For a facing-based spell, choose enemy targets and Match all filters; add F41 facing enemy and a distance cap.

steps.zh: 撤退：选择米拉娜跳跃或原力法杖，以敌人为方向参照，目的地选择背离目标。原力法杖实际对自己施放。
steps.en: For retreat, choose Mirana Leap or Force Staff, use an enemy as the direction reference and select Away from target. Force Staff actually targets the caster.

value.zh: 正前方左右各15°，总夹角30°，包含边界；无可调角度或距离参数。
value.en: Horizontal ±15°, total 30°, inclusive boundary; no adjustable angle or distance parameter.

notes.zh: F41不会主动转身，不检查技能宽度、不预测移动，也不保证命中；按优先级会让距离与朝向成为不同候选组。
notes.en: F41 does not turn the caster, check spell width, predict movement or guarantee hits. Priority mode makes distance and facing separate candidate tiers.

notes.zh: 这两种撤退动作不显示落点距离；转身过程可能产生少量行走，确认朝向后才施放。目标失效、移动受限等情况会取消；不保证安全落点或越障。
notes.en: These retreat actions do not expose destination distance. Turning may cause a small walk before facing is confirmed and casting proceeds. Invalid targets or movement restrictions can cancel it; safe landings and obstacle crossing are not guaranteed.

title.zh: 冷却、动作下令与成功连招
title.en: Cooldown, orders and successful action chains

description.zh: U44检查正在冷却；U21～U23检查下令历史；U39检查成功执行。三者不能互相替代。
description.en: U44 checks cooldown, U21–U23 inspect order history and U39 checks successful execution. They are different observations.

steps.zh: 需要在另一技能冷却期间使用当前动作时，添加U44并选择所需英雄的技能；默认动作引用为当前动作。
steps.en: To act while another ability is cooling down, add U44 and select that hero's ability; the default reference is the current action.

steps.zh: 需要跳刀成功后衔接刃甲等连招时使用U39，并选择前置技能或物品和时间窗口。
steps.en: For Blink into Blade Mail or another chain, use U39 with the prerequisite skill or item and a time window.

value.zh: 原生剩余冷却>0时通过；就绪、技能不存在或无法读取时不通过。
value.en: Passes when native cooldown remaining is greater than zero; ready, missing or unreadable abilities fail.

notes.zh: U21/U22从未下令时不通过，U23统计下令次数而不是命中次数。U39当前动作成功后消费一次前置触发，成功不代表命中或持续施法结束。
notes.en: U21/U22 fail without prior orders; U23 counts orders, not hits. U39 consumes a prerequisite trigger when the current action succeeds. Success is not impact or channel completion.

notes.zh: 把U44指向当前待施放技能通常会与技能必须就绪的要求冲突；此条件常用于观察另一个技能。
notes.en: Referencing the action being cast with U44 usually conflicts with its readiness requirement; use it to observe a different ability.

description.zh: 已登记父技能与结束动作的组合，可以观察当前引导时长后执行对应释放。
description.en: Registered parent and release pairs can execute their matching release after observing current channel duration.

steps.zh: 先配置启动技能，再为动作列表中可用的对应结束动作建立独立规则。光之守卫冲击波对应释放为keeper_of_the_light_illuminate_end。
steps.en: Configure startup, then add a separate rule for its available release action. Illuminate uses keeper_of_the_light_illuminate_end.

steps.zh: 结束动作的使用条件选同时满足，添加U40当前持续施法时长≥所需秒数及U43对应释放动作可用。
steps.en: For the release action, select Match all and add U40 channel duration ≥ the desired seconds plus U43 release action available.

value.zh: U40/U41使用当前原生引导计时；U42观察生命周期阶段；U43要求对应释放已学习、可见且激活。
value.en: U40/U41 use current native channel time; U42 observes lifecycle phase; U43 requires a learned, visible, active matching release.

notes.zh: 没有当前持续施法时，时长条件不按0秒通过。下令时间、成功施法时间都不是持续施法完成时间。
notes.en: Without a current channel, duration checks do not pass as zero seconds. Order time and cast success are not channel completion.

notes.zh: 仅支持明确匹配的结束动作，不能用普通技能任意打断自身引导；未适配的非引导蓄力或多阶段技能不属于此流程。
notes.en: Only explicitly mapped releases are supported; ordinary spells cannot arbitrarily interrupt the caster's channel. Unsupported non-channel charges and multistage spells are outside this workflow.

description.zh: 通过F39/F40选择阵容头像，固定规则的候选对象。
description.en: Use F39/F40 roster portraits to select a specific candidate for a rule.

steps.zh: 先选对应目标阵营，再选择指定敌方或指定友方头像。需要指定对象同时低血量时，组合模式必须选同时满足。
steps.en: Choose the target team, then its specified enemy or ally portrait. Use Match all when that unit must also satisfy a health gate.

value.zh: 指定目标死亡、离场或不合法时该筛选不匹配；只有显式配置按优先级后续组或另一条规则才会回退。
value.en: A dead, absent or illegal specified target does not match; fallback requires an explicit later Priority tier or another rule.

notes.zh: 友方按英雄身份恢复；敌方引用受当前关卡约束，换关后需重新检查选择。点目标使用选中单位当前位置，不能绕过原生目标限制。
notes.en: Allied references follow hero identity; enemy references are tied to the current stage and need review after a stage change. Point casts use the selected unit's current position and retain native restrictions.

description.zh: 买活使用独立的启用开关，不使用普通技能的目标、筛选或追击设置。
description.en: Buyback has its own enable switch and does not use ordinary spell targets, filters or chase settings.

steps.zh: 为英雄添加买活行动并启用；战斗中死亡后由系统检查是否可以付费复活。
steps.en: Add and enable a Buyback action for the hero; after death in combat the system checks paid revival eligibility.

value.zh: 每个英雄每场战斗最多成功付费买活一次；实际价格以界面与当前难度为准。
value.en: Each hero can successfully buy back once per battle; use the displayed price for the current difficulty.

notes.zh: 金币不足、处于原生重生流程等情况不会强制买活；启用买活不会跳过资格检查。
notes.en: Insufficient gold or native reincarnation can prevent buyback; enabling it does not bypass eligibility checks.

description.zh: 按自己或目标身上的状态决定何时行动。先确认状态名称，再选择有无、层数或剩余时间。
description.en: Act based on a status on yourself or your target. Confirm its name, then choose presence, stacks or remaining time.

value.zh: 缩地规则：使用条件 → 自身没有指定状态 → modifier_weaver_shukuchi
value.en: Shukuchi rule: use condition → self does not have modifier → modifier_weaver_shukuchi

value.zh: 另一条动作规则：自身状态剩余时间≤1秒；状态填写 modifier_weaver_shukuchi
value.en: A separate action rule: self modifier time remaining ≤1 second; modifier_weaver_shukuchi

value.zh: 使用条件选自身状态层数≥N；检查目标则用目标筛选中的状态层数。N按技能调整。
value.en: Use self modifier stacks ≥N; for another unit, use target modifier stack filters. Tune N to the spell.

steps.zh: 先选要执行的动作。检查自己放在“使用条件”，检查选中的敌人或队友放在“目标筛选”。
steps.en: Select the action first. Check yourself in Use conditions; check the selected enemy or ally in Target filters.

steps.zh: 缩地可直接使用上面的状态名称；其他技能从已观察状态列表选择对应状态；内部名称用于核对，不是中文技能名。未观察到的状态不能作为新选项直接选择。
steps.en: Use the status name above for Shukuchi. For other spells, select the matching observed status. Internal names help identify it; unobserved statuses cannot be newly selected.

steps.zh: 如果想“没有状态，或者状态快结束”都施放，将使用条件切到“按优先级”，分别添加两项。另有必须满足的血量门槛时，应拆成两条“同时满足”规则并各自添加血量门槛。
steps.en: For absent OR nearly expired, select Priority use conditions and add both clauses. If a health gate must always hold, use two Match all rules and repeat that gate in each.

notes.zh: 状态不存在时，层数和剩余时间条件不通过；永久状态不会满足剩余≤1秒。
notes.en: Absent statuses fail stack and duration comparisons. Permanent statuses do not satisfy remaining time ≤1 second.

notes.zh: 当前同名状态不按施加者分开，多个实例取可读取的最大层数或最长剩余时间。
notes.en: Same-name statuses are not separated by their caster; multiple instances use the greatest readable stack count or remaining duration.

description.zh: 全图技能不必等敌人走近。以宙斯雷神之怒为例，用存活敌人数代替附近敌人数。
description.en: Global spells need not wait for nearby enemies. For Thundergod's Wrath, use living-enemy count instead of nearby-enemy count.

value.zh: 敌方；最近。雷神之怒本身按无目标技能释放。
value.en: Enemy; nearest. Thundergod's Wrath itself casts without a unit target.

value.zh: 存活敌人数≥1；可加战斗时间≥1秒
value.en: Living enemies ≥1; optionally battle time ≥1 second

value.zh: 不添加近距离上限，也不要求附近有敌人
value.en: Do not add a short distance cap or require nearby enemies

steps.zh: 选择雷神之怒，保留技能原本的施法方式。
steps.en: Select Thundergod's Wrath and retain its native casting mode.

steps.zh: 移除普通战斗预设中的附近敌人门槛，改成存活敌人数≥1。
steps.en: Remove the nearby-enemy gate from the ordinary combat preset and require at least one living enemy instead.

steps.zh: 其他远距离单位或地点技能仍需按自身用途选择目标，并遵守实际施法距离。
steps.en: Other long-range unit or point spells still need appropriate targets and must respect their actual cast range.

notes.zh: 这不会提供未知目标位置、自动传送或安全落点；全图技能的命中规则仍由技能本身决定。
notes.en: This does not provide unknown target positions, automatic teleportation or safe landing points. The spell still determines who is hit.

description.zh: 小小投掷有两个不同对象：身边被抓起的单位，以及规则选中的落点目标。两者分别设置。
description.en: Tiny's Toss has two different subjects: the unit grabbed nearby and the destination target selected by the rule. Configure them separately.

value.zh: 被抓单位是敌方；被抓单位是英雄（两项同时满足）
value.en: Grabbed unit is enemy AND grabbed unit is hero

value.zh: 敌方；最近；有需要再加落点目标的血量或距离筛选
value.en: Enemy; nearest. Optionally filter the destination target by health or distance

steps.zh: 选择小小的投掷，打开条件设置。
steps.en: Choose Tiny's Toss and open Condition settings.

steps.zh: 用“被抓单位”使用条件限制实际抓取对象；不要用普通目标血量筛选代替被抓单位血量条件。
steps.en: Use Grabbed unit conditions for the actual grabbed unit. Ordinary target-health filters do not check the grabbed unit's health.

steps.zh: 再设置落点目标和排序。小小抓树已有自动处理，学会且可用时无需另找地图树木。
steps.en: Then configure the destination target and ordering. Tree Grab already has automatic handling when learned and available; you do not need to find map trees.

notes.zh: 检查的是抓取范围内最近的可抓单位，不会越过近处队友去找远处敌人。没有候选或距离并列时，这组抓取条件不通过。
notes.en: The check uses the nearest grabbable unit. It does not skip a nearby ally for a farther enemy. No candidate or a distance tie fails these grab conditions.

notes.zh: 这只是已支持对象的示例；不能直接套到尸体、建筑、残岩或其他专属对象。
notes.en: This is an example of a supported object contract, not a generic recipe for corpses, buildings, stones or other special objects.

description.zh: 获得升级后，新增技能单独设置；原技能也要检查目标方式和范围是否改变。以龙骑士的变身与火球为例。
description.en: After an upgrade, configure new abilities separately and check whether existing spells changed target mode or range. Dragon form and Fireball illustrate this distinction.

value.zh: 变身技能：自身；自身800范围内敌人数≥1
value.en: Form ability: self; at least one enemy within 800

value.zh: 另建该技能规则：敌方；最近；按实际作用范围设置敌人门槛
value.en: Create a separate rule: enemy; nearest; set combat gates for the actual spell area

steps.zh: 先确认当前版本的升级确实提供了技能，而且技能已出现在英雄动作列表中。
steps.en: First confirm the current upgrade actually grants the ability and that it appears in the hero's action list.

steps.zh: 新增技能建立新规则，不要把原来的变身规则当作火球施放规则。
steps.en: Create a new rule for an additional skill. A form-activation rule does not also cast Fireball.

steps.zh: 升级改变敌友目标、施法方式或范围后，重新核对目标与筛选；需要形态条件时参考“增益、层数与剩余时间”。
steps.en: Recheck target team, casting mode and filters after upgrades change them. For form gates, consult Buffs, stacks and time remaining.

notes.zh: 未拥有、未学习、隐藏或禁用的技能不会因为填了规则就变得可用。教程不自动购买升级或选择形态连招。
notes.en: Rules do not make unowned, unlearned, hidden or disabled abilities available. The guide does not buy upgrades or plan form-specific combos.

title.en: Spells that cost your own health

description.zh: 救队友时也要检查施法者血量。亚巴顿迷雾缠绕可以作为自损治疗的例子。
description.en: Check your own health while helping an ally. Abaddon's Mist Coil is an example of healing with a health cost.

value.zh: 友方；生命百分比最低
value.en: Ally; lowest health percentage

value.zh: 自身生命百分比≥70%
value.en: Self health ≥70%

value.zh: 目标生命百分比≤60%；排除自己
value.en: Target health ≤60%; exclude self

steps.zh: 先套用治疗友方规则，再增加自身血量下限。
steps.en: Start with an ally-healing rule, then add a minimum self-health gate.

steps.zh: 自身血量放在使用条件，队友血量放在目标筛选。
steps.en: Put your own health in Use conditions and the ally's health in Target filters.

steps.zh: 按当前技能生命消耗和自身最大生命调整70%的起点。
steps.en: Adjust the 70% starting threshold for the spell's health cost and your maximum health.

notes.zh: 比例门槛不会预测扣血后的存活，也不会判断交换位置、拉扯队友或友军误伤是否划算；这些风险不能只靠一条血量条件解决。
notes.en: A percentage gate does not predict survival after the cost, or whether swaps, ally displacement or friendly fire are worthwhile.

title.zh: 同一技能治疗友方、伤害敌方
title.en: One spell for ally healing and enemy damage

description.zh: 原本允许敌友两用的技能，分别建立救人和伤害两条规则。仍以亚巴顿迷雾缠绕为例。
description.en: For a spell that natively allows both teams, create separate healing and damage rules. Mist Coil provides an example.

value.zh: 友方；目标生命≤60%；排除自己；生命百分比最低；自身生命≥70%
value.en: Ally; target HP ≤60%; exclude self; lowest HP percentage; self HP ≥70%

value.zh: 敌方；目标生命≤30%；当前生命值最低；自身生命≥70%
value.en: Enemy; target HP ≤30%; lowest current health; self HP ≥70%

steps.zh: 添加两条同技能规则，分别设置友方和敌方目标。
steps.en: Add two rules for the same skill, with ally and enemy targets respectively.

steps.zh: 救人规则放在伤害规则之前，先尝试救助合格队友。
steps.en: Place the healing rule above the damage rule to try eligible allies first.

steps.zh: 两条规则分别保存，目标阵营和筛选不会自动从另一条继承。
steps.en: Save each rule separately; neither inherits the other's target team or filters.

notes.zh: 这不是同时施放两次：技能冷却和资源仍然共享。选择敌方不会把纯友方技能变成伤害技能，允许自身也不会绕过技能禁止自身的限制。
notes.en: This does not cast twice at once: cooldown and resources are shared. Enemy targeting does not turn an ally-only spell into damage, and allowing self does not override native self-target restrictions.

title.zh: U45 即将被范围技能命中

description.zh: 为观察到的范围威胁配置一次应对，保留本行已选动作。
description.en: Configure one response per observed area threat using the selected row action.

value.zh: 走出范围；80～500毫秒；每条规则最多一个U45。
value.en: Walk; 80–500 ms; at most one U45 per rule.

steps.zh: 选择1走出范围，或2使用本行已选装备/技能防御或跳走。仅当U45实际匹配时走位替代本行动作；按优先级/或条件选中其他条件时仍执行本行动作。
steps.en: Choose 1 Walk out or 2 Use the selected row item/ability to defend or escape. Walk overrides the row action only when U45 actually matches; another selected Priority/OR clause keeps the normal row action.

steps.zh: 仅应对已释放且已观察到的威胁，不根据前摇反应。首次观察到已释放威胁时抽取一次反应时间并开始计时，每个威胁仅应对一次。
steps.en: Respond only to observed, released threats, never windup. Sample and start reaction time at the first observation of a released threat; respond once per threat.

steps.zh: 反应最小值/最大值限制0～2000毫秒并按大小排序。将应急规则放在所需优先位置。应急时目标筛选检查自身。
steps.en: Reaction bounds are ordered and limited to 0–2000 ms. Place emergency rules at the desired priority. Emergency target filters inspect self.

notes.zh: 当前仅支持观察光击阵、撕裂大地、洪流，并非所有范围技能。不会自动取消自己正在进行的原生施法或持续施法。
notes.en: Initial observation supports Light Strike Array, Split Earth and Torrent, not every area spell. Responses do not automatically cancel your own native cast or channel.

notes.zh: 使用当前选定动作，不自动另选技能。自身/无目标技能可防护；普通点目标自动选安全逃离点。单体技能须合法指向自身；不支持矢量、开关、自动施法或被动动作，也不能同时指定额外落点/预测偏移。任意技能不保证保护效果，仍须确认实际防御或位移用途。
notes.en: Uses the selected action without choosing another ability. Self/no-target actions can protect; ordinary point casts select a safe escape point. Unit casts must legally target self. Vector, toggle, autocast and passive actions are unsupported, as are simultaneous destination/prediction offsets. Arbitrary skills do not guarantee protection; verify the action actually defends or moves you.
